title: Regular limiting subobjects from finite diagonal tails
statement: There exists a limiting subobject object for the canonical cycle-boundary tower, and the exact couple is regular, under the finite diagonal tail hypotheses of lem-sp-finite-cocone-exact-couple.

proof.text: Apply finiteCocone_stationary to obtain eventual constancy of cycles and boundaries at each bidegree. Choose a stationary index, define the limiting subobjects there, and use monotonicity plus eventual equality to prove the GLB and LUB conditions. Eventual cycle equality gives regularity.

lean.statement: theorem finiteCocone_limits {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (A : ∀ n : ℤ, X.AlphaColimit n) (hA : ∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, (∀ P : ℤ, P ≤ a → IsIso ((A n).ι P)) ∧ (∀ P : ℤ, b ≤ P → IsZero (X.D P (n - P)))) : ∃ L : X.LimitSubobjects, X.IsRegular
